findings.finding: Current API explains text prompt embeds and only distinguishes media embeds; CPU HF preprocessing, placeholder mapping and processor-cache miss/merge are not taught. PD/UCM EC cache is encoder outputs, not this CPU processing cache.
findings.proposal: Add one API entry subsection: image enters -> CPU processor output and placeholder range -> encoder output -> language forward. Explain CPU preprocessing cache versus EC versus KV in a small table and link unique existing EC/KV teaching.

findings.finding: Official design mm_processing says dummy text workaround generally; baseline implementation only uses it for model custom _call_hf_processor; newer token-only API makes helper explicit per model.
findings.proposal: Explain purpose and condition, not universal operation. Four version column must include newer token-only implementation.

findings.finding: Config comment multiplies capacity by API+DP but registry falls back to processor_only in multi-API/internal-DP topology.
findings.proposal: State 4GiB is capacity setting; actual receiver duplication and shm vs lru depend on topology, not an unconditional physical-host allocation formula.

findings.finding: UUID omission requires actual cached data; rc2 keeps explicit UUIDs with both caches off, but baseline and840 replace them. New hash inputs include media IO kwargs.
findings.proposal: Show valid same-media UUID reuse plus cache-miss failure; user IDs are a content identity contract, not automatic proof same media. Distinguish versions.
